An '''Ultra Droideka''' was a larger variant of a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]], used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. An oversized version of a regular droideka, it had considerably more powerful weapons, but required a tremendous amount of energy to sustain its [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]]. As a result, it often operated in the shieldless mode when there were other droids around to protect it.

==History==
During the Clone Wars, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] infiltrated a secret Separatist facility responsible for the manufacturing of Ultra Droidekas to prevent their use against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
